findings.evidence: Grep hit: line 113 has `(hst : e '' s = t)` for membership in `fixingSubgroup ... t`; line 105 already proves fixing all of `e '' s`, and `code/TauCeti/Geometry/Diffeomorphism/FixingSubgroup.lean:98` provides `fixingSubgroup_antitone`, so fixing the larger image set implies fixing any subset `t`.
findings.fix: Generalize this lemma to a subset hypothesis, e.g. `(ht : t ⊆ e '' s)`, and derive the equality-named version from it if desired.
findings.issue: `diffCongr_mem_fixingSubgroup_of_image_eq` requires `hst : e '' s = t`, but to prove the conjugate fixes `t` it is enough that `t ⊆ e '' s`.

findings.evidence: Grep hit: line 133 has `(hst : e '' s = t)`; in the proof obligation for `x ∈ s`, the only needed fact is `ψ (e x) = e x`, available from `hψ` if `Set.mem_image_of_mem e hx` is mapped into `t` by an inclusion.
findings.fix: Generalize this lemma to `(ht : e '' s ⊆ t)` and specialize with equality for the exact-image API.
findings.issue: `diffCongr_symm_mem_fixingSubgroup_of_image_eq` also requires equality, but the reverse membership only needs `e '' s ⊆ t` so that every `e x` with `x ∈ s` lies in the set fixed by `ψ`.

summary: The subgroup equivalence sits at the natural equality level, but the named-target membership lemmas assume equality where only inclusion is needed.
